title: People, machine admission and personal tokens
scope: Personal identity and the selected organization
encounter: Connect another computer, invite a teammate or create a personal token
location: Connect and setup; Team, Machines and Profile
basis: Shared engine decisions, invite ownership and token controls
note: The agent approves machine and GitHub codes; only password entry goes to a person. A machine belongs to the person whose signed-in browser or connected machine approved it. Agents hand private invite input to the human TUI and never receive the secret as an answer.
current: Source separates own-machine approval, teammate invitation and explicit personal tokens. Hosted and company-sign-in teammates sign in as themselves. A local universe is reachable here only; yoke self-host init is the sharing path.
desired: Prove the same identities, recovery and secret boundaries from published installers and deployed browser surfaces.
